brief: Large old gambrel barn about 40 ft wide and 60 ft long, sided in horizontal drop siding that has weathered to brown-grey with only ghosts of red paint, under a weathered grey wood-shingle gambrel roof. The long side has a pair of big sliding plank doors on an overhead track, a hinged stall door, two small white-framed windows and a round wreath-like ornament hung on the wall; white-painted boards at the corner. Huge old cottonwoods stand in front of it along a gravel drive, a board fence runs off to the pasture.
